text_zh: 墨未干，蜡未凝——暗处亦有买卖。其价不在什一，而在汝之所愿舍弃者。
text_en: Ink still wet, wax yet warm—trade flourishes in shadow's embrace. Its price lies not in tithe, but in what thou wouldst surrender.

text_zh:
门券莫名其妙地出现在第█层的抄写台上。

分级：Safe
来源：未记录（无征用表单F-001存档）
描述：废料纸张制成，印刷质量粗糙。背面有手写划痕，疑似改写过的层级编号。持有者可进入未编册的补给点位。该点位库存包含更高分级的圣器，但采购依据不明。
备注：░░░层管理员要求销毁此物。命令被驳回——条例§4.2优先级更高。
处置：按标准流程分发给D级键徒。
text_en:
Tickets appear sporadically on scribal desks throughout Layer █.

Class: Safe
Origin: Unlogged (no F-001 requisition forms on file)
Description: Crude paper stock with poor print quality. Reverse side shows handwritten scratches, possibly altered layer numbers. Bearers gain access to uncatalogued supply stations. These stations stock higher-classification artifacts, though procurement authority remains unclear.
Note: ░░░ Layer supervisors requested destruction. Order overruled—§4.2 takes precedence.
Disposition: Standard distribution to D-Class keystroke personnel.
